text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Correlation of the hourly mean net power at the 8 MW Primaries with CAMS irradiance, on clear- sky hours (clear-sky index above 0.8, clear-sky irradiance above 100 W/m²), when the power stamps are shifted by the amount on the axis. Net power falls as irradiance rises, so the correlation is negative and the right shift makes it most negative. Thin lines: one site; thick line: the mean over sites.'
text.tspan: Correlation of the hourly mean net power at the 8 MW Primaries with CAMS irradiance, on clear-
sky hours (clear-sky index above 0.8, clear-sky irradiance above 100 W/m²), when the power
stamps are shifted by the amount on the axis. Net power falls as irradiance rises, so the
correlation is negative and the right shift makes it most negative. Thin lines: one site; thick
